pages.text: Store nine spell cores and cast the selected spell. Sneak-right-click to open its core inventory and transfer cores normally. Contents persist inside the wand.

pages.title: Casting and selection
pages.text: Right-click instant spells, hold and release charged spells, and hold continuous spells. Empty or unformed cores cannot cast.$(br2)Use L2ItemSelector keys to switch, normally Up/Down. The tooltip shows core count and current selection.

pages.title: Current limits
pages.text: Casting currently costs no resources and does not consume cores. Stored document data is limited to 512 KiB, so very large collections may not fit.
